title: Enterprise RAG Architecture: Vector Search & Prompt Engineering
description: Master enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platforms using document chunking, pgvector similarity search, hybrid BM25 search, prompt synthesis, and RAGAS evaluation.
body: Build production-ready grounded AI applications. Learn how to prevent LLM hallucinations, implement HNSW vector indexing in PostgreSQL, execute hybrid Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) search, and measure RAG precision.

sections.title: Section 1: Ingestion Pipelines & Document Chunking Strategies

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Why RAG is Essential for Enterprise LLMs
lessons.body:
### The Hallucination Problem
LLMs lack access to internal company wiki pages, live database records, and private documents. Passing an entire enterprise database into the context window is slow, expensive, and insecure. RAG retrieves relevant passages dynamically at query time.

Lesson 2.2: Hybrid BM25 + Dense Search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)
lessons.body:
### Sparse + Dense Retrieval
Dense vector embeddings capture conceptual similarity but fail on exact technical error codes (e.g. `ERR-9012`). Combining sparse keyword search (BM25) with dense vector search using RRF solves keyword matching failures.
